content:
sanjay: quick async — proposing to roll the new feature-flag `cache_batch_v2` in prod tonight. plan: 5% canary on the dedicated GPU pool (dedicated-gpu-eu1) for a 2h window. goal is ~10-15% token cost reduction with <5% p99 latency regression. checklist and rollback commands below, please ACK if you can watch metrics. :pray:

leah: which tenants are in the canary? we should exclude enterprise customers and any orgs with active compliance syncs.

sanjay: will route 5% across non-exempt orgs. exemption list = /ops/rollout-blocklist (we'll exclude org_ids in that file). KV invalidation behavior: no global clear; only per-key TTL changes. watch `kv.cache.hit_ratio` — if it drops >10% we rollback.

tom: can you paste the dashboards/alerts? add the grafana links and the alert IDs so oncall can triage fast.

sanjay: dashboard links: https://grafana.redwood/d/infra/cache-batch-v2 (overview) and https://grafana.redwood/d/infra/latency-tiles (latency heatmap). alerts: `ALERT_CB_LATENCY_P99` (p99 > baseline*1.05 for 5m), `ALERT_CB_ERRORS` (5xx rate > baseline + 0.5%).

maya: PR status? is the runtime change merged and versioned? I want to run the smoke runner once flag flips.

sanjay: PR #5123 merged, image tag `release/cb-v2-2024-11-08`. deployment pipeline ID `dep-94823`. CI smoke job name `smoke/cache-batch-v2`.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline `dep-94823` queued by sanjay — stage: canary config apply.

ci-bot: smoke tests queued: smoke/cache-batch-v2 -> waiting for canary traffic.

danny: oncall — FYI we have a storage migration job at 19:00 PT that may spike backend write latency. canary at 18:00-20:00 will overlap. recommend moving canary out of that window or limit to 2 nodes.

sanjay: good catch @danny — let's shift canary to 21:30-23:30 PT and keep it 5% across 10 pods. that avoids migration window. all good?

tom: sounds fine. I'll add the following telemetry snippet to the runbook (for quick copy/paste):

```
# metrics to copy during canary
SELECT
  percentile(latency_ms, 50) as p50,
  percentile(latency_ms, 95) as p95,
  percentile(latency_ms, 99) as p99,
  sum(errors) / sum(requests) as error_rate,
  avg(kv_hit_ratio) as kv_hit
FROM metrics.requests
WHERE service = 'runtime' AND tag = 'cache_batch_v2' AND ts > now() - 15m;
```

leah: rollback command please (quickest way).

sanjay: rollback (flip flag off):

```
# flip flag off for pool
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/flags/cache_batch_v2/disable \
  -d '{"scope":"pool:dedicated-gpu-eu1"}'
# or full rollback
kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime -n prod --to-revision=release/cb-v1
```

maya: I'll run smoke tests after canary starts and report results in this thread. I'll check 20 sample requests through the e2e harness and post latency+outputs.

danny: oncall ack — I'll watch ALARM channels and be ready to flip if `ALERT_CB_LATENCY_P99` fires. please ping me @danny if you see gradual regressions.

sanjay: acceptance criteria before we expand to 25%:
- p99 <= baseline * 1.05 for 30m window
- error_rate increase <= 0.5 percentage points
- kv_hit_ratio drop <= 10%
- cost_per_token reduction >= 8% (we'll tolerate lower but rollout pause if <4%)

sanjay: plan timeline (updated):
- 21:30 PT: enable 5% canary on dedicated-gpu-eu1
- 21:40 PT: start smoke runner (maya)
- 21:40-22:30 PT: watch metrics, collect queries (tom)
- 22:30 PT: decision point -> expand to 25% or rollback

ops-bot: canary toggled: pool=dedicated-gpu-eu1 pct=5 — status: applied

maya: smoke runner started, posting results in 15m. :eyes:

sanjay: thanks all — please drop +1 or :thumbsup: if you can watch. I'll do the expansion only with explicit ACKs from eng-infra + oncall.

leah: +1, watching kv/latency.

tom: +1, will hold dashboard watch.

danny: +1, oncall monitoring.

maya: smoke: p50 20ms p95 80ms p99 180ms, errors 0.02% (no regression vs baseline), kv_hit ~ 0.87 (baseline 0.92) — still within thresholds. posting raw logs to /ops/canaries/2045123456.

sanjay: results look good — will prep expansion PR for 25% but won't apply without 2 more ACKs. updating runbook and adding short note to incident timeline.

ops-bot: note created: /ops/canaries/2045123456 — status=canary-running, watchers=[sanjay,leah,tom,maya,danny].

ci-bot: smoke job completed: success (20/20).

sanjay: end of thread for now — will post if we move to 25% or rollback. thanks everyone.
